Load from External

Pick channels from preconfigured lists. Importing creates a zone and scan list for each group in your workspace.

Preconfigured channels

Receive only by default. FRS, GMRS, MURS and Marine each require radios certified for that service before they may transmit, and GMRS also needs an FCC licence. MOTOTRBO business radios generally aren't, so channels import as receive-only unless you untick RX only on a group, or tick Allow transmit under Import options. Weather, and the government-only and data-only marine channels, are always receive-only.

Texas GMRS repeaters

Built-in GMRS repeaters, grouped by the Texas Comptroller's regions (Panhandle, North, East, Central, Gulf Coast and so on). Each region gets its own zone and scan list. TX is the output + 5 MHz with the repeater's uplink tone. Closed, off-air and unverified repeaters start unticked. Repeaters without a published uplink tone are receive only. Data courtesy of RepeaterBook.com, Dallas County REACT and the Houston Amateur Mobile Society.

Update from RepeaterBook

To add newer listings, open the Texas GMRS repeater list, select the table from the Frequency header to the last row, and paste it below (a CHIRP CSV export also works). Repeaters already built in are skipped. New ones join their region. The pasted data stays in this browser.

Import options

Each group becomes a zone named as shown, and a scan list with the same name. Larger groups are split into numbered scan lists ("Marine", "Marine 2", …). If the zone already exists in your workspace, channels with the same name are replaced and new ones are added.
